svg.text: DRAWING REVIEW ONLY. Hidden upper torso and all sections are INTERPOLATED.
Filled animation construction drawings. Same section widths/depths determine all three views. No 3D surface exists.
Pale blue = surface flow, never a seam or fold. Short arms / neck / waist show context only.
A-E | whole torso cross-sections, common drawing scale
BACK above / FRONT below. One continuous perimeter per level. No attached anterior circles or cup outlines.
Reference overlays | A visible body B garment boundary P pose/camera C hidden reconstruction
Official pixels stay unchanged. Orange proposals are conceptual pose checks, not calibrated body projections.
A: lower purple side is directly visible.
B: white opening and hems are garment edges.
C: covered upper volume stays hypothetical.
A: no free upper-chest silhouette to trace.
P: sitting, bracing and camera affect contour.
A: exposed purple sides below the hem.
P/C: oblique arms hide the upper wrap.
S1 neutral front / side | SECONDARY STRUCTURE ONLY
Upright posture supports structural reasoning. Cups and fitted bodice still hide the body.
No S1 costume edge or total neutral depth becomes a body measurement.
Anterior/medial shape and posterior limits stay C. S4 has priority where sources disagree.
No mesh edit, GLB build, garment edit or new geometry test. Stop for drawing review.
